Listen to 9to5Mac's daily recap of the top Apple news stories. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes, the Apple Podcasts app, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, and through our dedicated RSS feed on Overcast and other podcast players.

Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you get everything out of your head and into a simple, elegant system—clear out unfinished tasks and reduce mental clutter. A straightforward to-do list app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools that make organising, tracking, and completing tasks more satisfying. So you can finally get everything done.

New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Subscribe to our podcast on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player to make sure new episodes are delivered straight to your ears as soon as they're released.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • AT&T appears to have no plans to support Apple's new Handoff feature on iPhone
  • Disney+ and Hulu are raising prices again—here are the latest rates
  • Apple says a software update to fix the iPhone 18 Pro reboot bug will arrive next week
  • Some users' iPhone 18 Pro Face ID bug is causing system crashes and reboots
  • The iPhone iOS 27.0.1 update is coming soon
